newsitems.title: Quack Quack Test FAQ | Everything You Need to Know
newsitems.author: 苏苏鸭
newsitems.contents: Dear Rocos, The Roco Kingdom Quack Quack Test (Closed Beta Test) begins on October 27, 2026, at 02:00 (UTC+0)! To help you prepare for the journey ahead, we've put together answers to some of the community's most frequently asked questions. Let's dive in! ▶Sign-ups are now open for our Closed Beta, the Quack Quack Test: www.rocokingdom.comTest overview・Start time: October 27, 2026, at 02:00 (UTC+0)・Platforms: PC, Android, and iOS・Supported languages: English and Japanese・In-game purchases: Not available・Cross-platform progression: Progress will sync across PC and mobile during the test・Test data: All characters and progress will be wiped at the end of the testQuack Quack Test FAQQ1. What is the Quack Quack Test, and when does it start?The Quack Quack Test is the Closed Beta Test (CBT) for Roco Kingdom. The test officially goes live on October 27, 2026, at 2:00 UTC+0.Q2. Which languages are supported in this test?The in-game languages supported in this test are English and Japanese. Please note that the game is still under active development and optimization. The available language options and localization quality in this build do not represent the final quality of the game at launch.Q3. How do I sign up for the Quack Quack Test?Head over to the official Roco Kingdom website, where you can either register for a Level Infinite account or log into your existing one. Once logged in, pre-register for the game, click JOIN THE TEST, and complete the recruitment questionnaire to submit your application. You can also follow our official social channels and join our community events for a chance to secure a spot!X (Twitter): https://x.com/RocoKingdomEN Discord: https://discord.gg/rocokingdom Please note: Test access will be granted based on region, platform, device specifications, questionnaire responses, and overall testing requirements. Q4. Can I update my sign-up information after submitting my application?In most cases, it cannot be modified after submission. Please double-check your email address and other details to avoid any issues that could affect test access or account login during the test.Q5. How do I check if I have beta access?Starting October 23, you can log into your Level Infinite account on the official Roco Kingdom website to check your beta status. We will also send out confirmation emails in waves before the test begins, and post updates across our official community channels. If you don't receive an email, you can always check your status on the website.Please keep your Level Infinite account details safe, verify that your linked info is correct, and stay tuned for official announcements!Q6. What do I do if I don't receive a confirmation email?Please check your spam or junk folders and double-check that the email address you used when signing up is correct. If we announce that all beta invitations have been sent but you have not received one, you may not have been selected for this test.Q7. What platforms will the test be available on?This test will be available on both PC and mobile platforms. For detailed download and installation instructions, please refer to Q10, Q11, Q12, and Q13.Q8. Can I share, sell, or transfer my beta access to someone else?No. Beta access is strictly non-transferable and cannot be shared, gifted, rented, sold, or traded. Any account sharing or selling is strictly prohibited. We reserve the right to revoke beta access and any related rewards for any violation of these rules.Q9. Which account should I use to log into the game?You must log in using the Level Infinite account that was granted beta access. Attempting to log in with any other account will block your access.Q10. How do I download the PC Launcher after being granted test access?Once you've received your confirmation email, you can either click the Pre-Download – PC Launcher button in the email, or visit the official Roco Kingdom website, sign in with your Level Infinite account to confirm your eligibility, and download the PC Launcher.Q11. How can I participate in the test on Android?After receiving your confirmation email, tap the Pre-Download – Google Play button to open the Google Play Store app. Sign in with an eligible Google account and install the test build.Please note: If your Level Infinite account was not registered using a Gmail account, you may not be able to download the game through Google Play. Q12. How can I participate in the test on iOS? After receiving your confirmation email, tap the Pre-Download – App Store button to open the TestFlight invitation page. If you do not already have TestFlight installed, please download it first. Then return to the invitation page, accept the invitation, and install the Roco Kingdom test build using TestFlight. Q13. What should I do if TestFlight asks for a Redeem Code? Please return to your confirmation email or the download page and click the TestFlight invitation link again. Follow the instructions to accept the invitation and access the test build. Q14. ...

newsitems.title: Roco Kingdom | Official Announcement Trailer
newsitems.author: 苏苏鸭
newsitems.contents: From the Magic Academy to the vast, vibrant world beyond, discover the secrets of Jinies, explore the lands they call home, and perhaps even find your own calling along the way.As a Roco, meeting Jinies is only the beginning.Take the time to observe them, listen to them, and discover how they live. A cautious encounter can slowly turn into trust. A shared journey can blossom into friendship. And one day, a Jini you once watched from afar may choose to stand by your side.Meet. Bond. Journey together.▶Watch the full trailer on our official YouTube channel: Roco Kingdom is a new evolution of open-world creature-collecting games, where players become Rocos and set out to meet Jinies, the native creatures living across the continent of Carosia.This is your first step into an unknown world. Whatever brought you here, your journey is just beginning. ▶Sign-ups are now open for our first Closed Beta, the Quack Quack Test: www.rocokingdom.com Add the game to your wishlist and follow us!
